testimonials.subtitle: Accepted to international universities and scholarships.

items.full: Marilu's help throughout this process was essential. From the first consultation I was able to create my timeline for the key steps. Whenever doubts came up, I always turned to her and she was always willing to help. I am very grateful for how consistently she answered all the messages I sent her, because there were truly many.

Thanks to Marilu's mentoring, I strengthened my essays and prepared confidently for the interview with the Embassy of Ireland. Her guidance was essential to winning the scholarship. Beyond academics, she helped me trust myself, and I will always be grateful for her generosity and commitment.

I recommend the Mar de Becas team to anyone who wants to pursue a master's degree abroad. Their guidance was key to understanding the process, comparing options, and accessing funding through scholarships. I value their experience, warmth, and support at every stage of the journey.

Marilu, I do not have enough words to thank you for your unconditional support. Your expert guidance with the documents, together with your constant motivation, was essential to completing my application. Your advice is a treasure. Choosing the right advisor, like you, opens a world of possibilities.
